title: Transistor patents traced to 1930s Germany

tellings.quote: know, the patents for the transistor were found go back to Germany in the 1930s.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says in passing that the patents for the transistor, the tiny switch at the heart of all modern electronics, have been traced back to Germany in the 1930s. He raises it in an episode about the idea that artificial intelligence is alien technology, so the point, if true, would be that the roots of our computing age are older and stranger than the usual history says.
